work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

collection_state.note: Issue #93 remains active through the frozen collection cutoff.

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind inspection of four public candidate repositories for concrete executed cross-harness result artifacts. No benchmark was run and no missing metadata was inferred.

non_admission_dispositions.reason: The repository is an agentified evaluation pipeline for visual-world model outputs. Its public result surface evaluates world models rather than materially different AI-agent harnesses under a common task/model condition.

The public code supports multiple coding-agent harnesses and documents run-summary.json as the concrete result artifact, but the pinned repository tree does not contain committed run-summary.json benchmark outputs. W1 cannot execute missing benchmarks or invent scores.

The repository explicitly defines fixed-model harness-vs-harness evaluation over shared tasks, but the complete pinned tree contains runner/adapters/leaderboard-generation code and no committed harness-output or executed leaderboard result artifacts. W1 therefore preserves the design as a future evidence source without manufacturing an observation.
The inspected public results are for Simple Strands Agent and a separate ARC-AGI-3 agent rather than a controlled same-model comparison of materially different harnesses.
